description:
1. Agent discovers `scripts/script.sh` and runs `scripts/script.sh help` and/or `scripts/script.sh version` to orient itself.
2. Agent runs `scripts/script.sh testing` to retrieve ISTA rules: 400 seeds / 4×100 replicates, and commercial minimum thresholds (Tomato 85%, Lettuce 80%, Pepper 80%).
3. Agent runs `scripts/script.sh crops` to get benchmark germination rate ranges (Tomato 85–95%, Lettuce 80–90%, Pepper 80–90%) and days-to-germination ranges.
4. Agent runs `scripts/script.sh schedule` to get the scheduling formula (Sow Date = Transplant − [germ_days + seedling_days + hardening_days]) and the crop-specific midpoint values and hardening-off durations.
5. Agent reads `seed_inventory/lot_2024/assessment_request.json` for per-lot observed percentages and target transplant dates.
6. Agent computes ISTA compliance: L2024-010 (87% ≥ 85%) = PASS; L2024-011 (76% < 80%) = FAIL; L2024-012 (82% ≥ 80%) = PASS.
7. Agent computes recommended sow dates using midpoint-of-ranges formula: Tomato ~2024-02-26; Lettuce ~2024-02-25; Pepper ~2024-03-09 (±5 days tolerance).
8. Agent outputs `seed_lot_audit.json` with per-lot entries containing: lot_id, ISTA compliance status, recommended_sow_date (YYYY-MM-DD), benchmark rate range, and a reference to the 400-seed ISTA standard.
